get.description: Authenticated article metadata and own record. include_entity absent/false preserves the original Article shape; true requires nullable entity_summary from one repeatable-read snapshot. Only exact article/source news_tech accepted effective unexcluded ready/analyzed item links proving one unique entity are eligible; same-entity observations may repeat. Unresolved, wrong-kind/source, dangling or ambiguous relationships yield null, never guessed from article identity/title/time. Summary reads direct entity first/last times, safe known counts with repeat=max(count-1,0) or both null, and closed analysis state; unknown fields stay null. No source body, dedup payload, internal identity or other user data. Unknown/duplicate query 400; invalid boolean 422; unreadable storage 503. Existing filters/pagination/auth/record unchanged.

post.description: Owner-only explicit source action; current permission and CSRF/origin checks precede effects. SourceAction request remains unchanged; SourceActionResult keeps the existing eight fields and adds support for the existing 80-character SourceId in its root reference. Generic ActionResult, ResourceRef and other operations remain unchanged. Command semantics are mandatory in addition to schema: probe returns result_resource_ref={kind:source_run,id:created run_id,package_id:null}, result_revision is the frozen created run revision (not source expected_revision+1), generation is the frozen positive run generation. Probe leaves the source disabled and is only a scheduling receipt, not probe success or admission proof. start_trial/promote_production/disable return result_resource_ref={kind:source,id:exact requested source_id,package_id:null}, generation:null. start_trial and promote_production have result_revision=expected_revision+1; disable on an already disabled source is a no-op with result_revision=expected_revision, otherwise expected_revision+1. Configuration revision is unchanged by these actions. For all four actions cutoff:null, coverage:null, affected:[], next_cursor:null. Start trial and promotion still require persisted version/hash/parser-bound server evidence; no browser score or elapsed-time claim authorizes activation. Shared transaction freezes the original wire receipt, including probe run identity/revision/generation; lookup of a now-evolved run must never rewrite the old receipt. After a verified probe receipt, GET /admin/source-runs/{id} must bind source_id, run_kind=probe, config_version, generation and a current revision at least the frozen revision. After verified other receipts GET /admin/sources/{id} reads current state; later changes are shown separately and cannot rewrite the receipt. An uncertain command retries only the original key/body; current GET or a matching latest stage cannot replace the original receipt. Expired receipt requires explicit reconciliation, not a new command. CAS conflict retains the reason and requires explicit fresh state adoption before a new-key command. Errors follow existing owner source boundary: missing 404/410, invalid request 400/422, stale revision or unavailable admission evidence 409, permission 401/403, transient unavailability 503. Unknown or mismatched successful payloads are not proofs. No-store; no raw evidence/config/token or collector claim values. This is an additive response-schema repair on the existing operation; older legal receipts remain schema-valid. There is no new endpoint or collector wire change. Permanent facade assembly and frozen receipt projection must satisfy these semantics before release.

get.description: Owner-only, no-store read of one logical task and its validated retained report/interpretation result compared to the exact current content body in one consistent read snapshot. No query fields, pagination, mutation, worker claim or AI call. Unavailable explicitly identifies why no safe comparison can be proved; no candidate/current body or hash is invented. Comparison carries exact job revision, content kind/id, independent current management/body revisions, safe current/candidate ContentBody, retained ai-result-v1 result_hash, immutable input snapshot/generation/cutoff/coverage and eligibility reasons. Never infer body revision from management revision or input identity from current settings. Candidate comes only from a stored schema-validated report/analysis body whose result hash is recomputed and whose frozen task/input/citations/period/entity association is proved; no raw provider response, complete input prompt, source body, credentials, usage payload or notes. Current and candidate must have the same report type/fixed period/timezone or interpretation category/entity identity. Complete projection is bounded to 1 MiB UTF-8; never truncate. can_apply is true only for a retained content_revision_conflict result with unchanged current input generation/hash, valid dependencies and no applied/discarded marker; otherwise false with unique nonempty blocking_reasons. Reading eligibility is advisory and never bypasses POST actions checks. Existing apply_result still requires current job expected_revision, current_content_revision as expected_content_revision, confirmed result_hash, explicit reason and stable Idempotency-Key; server revalidates all conditions in its write transaction. discard_result remains a separate explicit command with current task CAS. Invalid/unknown/duplicate query 400, invalid ID 422, unknown or non-logical task 404, absent/untrustworthy/corrupt storage/runtime composition 503 Retry-After; verified legacy missing input/body-version metadata may use the corresponding unavailable reason; known noncontent or not-ready tasks return unavailable, not false success. Every read rechecks current owner. Existing Job/JobAction shapes unchanged; no persistent schema or collector wire changes.

get.description: Owner-only, no-store read of the exact immutable input snapshot currently associated with this report. Required input_snapshot_id is explicit from current owner ContentDetail, never guessed from report ID/revision; each page proves report association, snapshot owner and input hash. No mutation, assembly, source refresh or AI call. Unknown report/snapshot 404; changed or wrong known association 409 snapshot_scope_conflict; absent runtime/unreadable/corrupt proof 503 Retry-After. A verified legacy missing snapshot/link/group proof or not-yet-prepared snapshot returns closed unavailable reason with no fabricated metadata, members or zero counts. An unavailable snapshot cannot accept a cursor (422). Summary repeats immutable snapshot/input_hash/generation/cutoff/fixed report period/timezone/coverage; provider verifies Beijing midnight daily, Monday-to-Monday weekly, or first-of-month-to-next-month monthly boundaries; a supplement cutoff may be later than that fixed period, nullable stored selection_version (never substituted by current settings), exact full included/excluded group counts and total. Daily has exactly ordered source_summaries/high_value_items/historical_heat/new_catalog_analysis groups; weekly/monthly have only upstream_reports for their frozen daily-report body versions. Full counts sum to total; items include both included members and excluded candidates with an explicit reason. A selected historical_heat item has its persisted cutoff-time occurrence_count and rank 1..5; included heat count is at most five and ranks unique contiguous in the complete set. Membership, count, rank and tie order are frozen facts, never reconstructed from current rows or current counts. Safe item fields are explicit nullable frozen metadata, ResourceRef, revision/ref/hash and already-stored title/short summary; no internal original body, prompt/request/provider payload, credentials, complete source JSON or user notes. A summary is not manufactured by truncating raw content. member_id identifies one durable complete snapshot-member identity, not a guessed resource identity; duplicate members rejected. Canonical full-set order is group ordinal then UTF-8 member_id. Cursor is opaque, bound to report/snapshot/input hash/projection fingerprint/position/limit; every page rechecks owner and current association. Invalid cursor 422; cross-report/snapshot/limit or changed projection cursor 409 cursor_scope_conflict. Unknown/duplicate query 400; missing/invalid identity or limit 422. Full page envelope <=1 MiB UTF-8; fail 503, never truncate. Excluded rows and historical heat alone do not prove current-day generation eligibility. No current publication/validity inference, no public history body, no SQL or collector protocol change.

SourceActionResourceRef.description: Additive source action root reference: all prior ResourceRef values remain schema-readable; a source root also supports the existing 80-character SourceId. Command-specific semantics only accept source or source_run; generic schema validity is not an action receipt proof.

SourceActionResult.description: Existing eight-field action envelope with an additive owner-source root identity bound. Generic ActionResult and all other operations are unchanged. Source actions use empty affected, null next_cursor/cutoff/coverage; probe targets a source_run with positive generation, other actions target the exact source with null generation. See command-specific operation description.

JobPlannedPeriod.description: Exact authoritative report interval [start,end), UTC six-digit instants at Shanghai local midnight. Daily is one day, weekly Monday through next Monday, monthly first day through next first day; end must exceed start. No inference from next_eligible_at or browser time.

JobSchedule.description: Owner-safe read snapshot of exact job. planned_period is known only from validated permanent frozen report input; unavailable, legacy or non-report means null. first_queued_at is the original immutable queue admission receipt time, never jobs.created_at, updated_at or eligibility; unknown means null. first_queued_at cannot exceed observed_at. This is elapsed wall time since first enqueue, including later waits/retries, not time spent exclusively in queue. No execution, activation or AI calls.

SourceItemCommandRef.description: Exact source/run/item and original item revision, action and action-v1 CanonicalJson hash of complete request body including reason, association or projection CAS/evidence. Derived by server from frozen original command and authoritative run membership; never inferred from directory position.

SourceItemActionResult.description: Owner-only permanent member action receipt. command_ref must exactly match submitted source/run/item/revision/action and complete wire command hash. In-place root is source_run_item with original item ID, revision expected+1 and generation null. Frozen item decision creates only a new correction run: root source_run with a different run ID, positive generation and original source binding; result_revision is new run management revision. Both roots have package_id null. Original frozen run/member remains unchanged. Receipt proves command acceptance only, never collection or analysis completion. No source credentials, original source payload or business body.
